name: RealAI
description:
The RealAI Connector provides Claude access to RealAI’s authoritative real estate data catalog, spanning 126 million US properties (including 230,000 multifamily communities with unit-level operating detail), aggregated data on the 250 million people who live in them, their rent and leasing activity, and market/geographic data from the metro down to the census-block level.

RealAI doesn't just describe properties and places — it scores and ranks them. Every area and building carries normalized national and local benchmarks across hundreds of attributes, so RealAI can rank an entire population — markets, neighborhoods, or buildings — against any combination of criteria a user cares about, rather than profiling one place at a time off a fixed template.

Two examples of data depth most tools can't match: migration data that captures not just population flows but the age, income, wealth, and education profile of who is moving in versus out of a market; and unit-level rent-roll history built from nightly listings nationwide — asking vs. in-place rents, occupancy, days on market, rent growth, turnover, and tradeouts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RealAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RealAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.realai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RealAI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RealAI provides these MCP tools: entity_search_by_name, explore_data, and query_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RealAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RealAI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
RealAI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RealAI is developed by RealAI Systems, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
